text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 12, "unit": "mile", "kind": "distance", "span": "Marissa is hiking a 12-mile trail"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 4, "unit": "miles", "kind": "distance", "span": "She took 1 hour to walk the first 4 miles"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 2, "unit": "miles", "kind": "distance", "span": "another hour to walk the next two miles"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 4, "unit": "miles per hour", "kind": "speed", "span": "she wants her average speed to be 4 miles per hour"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 1, "unit": "hour", "kind": "time", "span": "She took 1 hour ... then another hour"}], "plan": [{"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "trail left after the first 4 miles"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s1", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "trail left after the next two miles"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["q1", "q4"], "out": "s3", "note": "the whole 12-mile trail at 4 miles per hour would take this long"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s3", "q5"], "out": "s4", "note": "take off the first hour already walked"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s4", "q5"], "out": "s5", "note": "take off the second hour as well"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s2", "s5"], "out": "s6", "note": "remaining distance over remaining time"}], "target": {"kind": "speed", "scope": "the speed in miles per hour needed for the rest of the trail"}, "dismissed": []}
